source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 8ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιος Αβδάς»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 8 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page heads him «(; - 303)» and says he was martyred by the sword «μάλλον μαζί με τον Άγιο Προκόπιο» — probably together with Procopius, and that «μάλλον» is the page's own hedge, kept as a hedge here. The corpus's `abda-bishop-of-persia` is a bishop of Persia on 5 September and 31 March and is another man. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).
